mall_exit.name: Sponsored Content
mall_exit.desc: Your new sponsor wants a highlight reel. The service lift down is behind the Food Court Kraken.

lost_child.name: Lost Child Announcement
lost_child.desc: “Would the parents of little Timmy please come to…” Madame Prickle says Timmy is real, and hiding. Check the Changing Rooms and Kiosk Ring.

hoa_violation.name: Notice of Violation
hoa_violation.desc: The HOA President has fined the entire fort out of existence. Big Deb wants the fines cancelled, permanently.

good_boy.name: Good Boy
good_boy.desc: The Neighbourhood Watch says Mr. Fetch was somebody’s dog once. Go to the Dog Park and find his old collar.

obj.label: Find the collar at the Dog Park

hunting_season.name: Hunting Season
hunting_season.desc: Tourists with hunting licences are stalking contestants through the Canopy. Turn the tables: take down 5 Tourist Hunters.

lodge_fire.name: Lodge Fire
lodge_fire.desc: The hunts are organised from the Glimmerkin Safari Lodge. End Lord-Hunter Facet’s season.

tallest_tree.name: The Roots of Things
tallest_tree.desc: Elder Lantern has seen scratch marks at the foot of the Tallest Tree that match nothing the Mothwing know.

tut_desk.name: Orientation
tut_desk.desc: You came down the stairs into the Network’s Orientation Centre. Find the desk and talk to the intern.

obj.label: Talk to Intern Pip at the Orientation Desk

tut_basics.name: Contestant Basics
tut_basics.desc: Pip wants you to learn the basics: drink from the fountain, open your Welcome Box, and hit a training dummy.

obj.label: Open your Welcome Box (I, then click it)

tut_arena.name: Cardboard Combat
tut_arena.desc: The practice arena has cardboard goblins. They hit back, softly. Watch for the red warnings and dodge (V) or parry (F).

tut_down.name: Going Down
tut_down.desc: That’s orientation done. Take the stairs at the far end down to Floor 1 and find Stairwell Camp.

obj.label: Take the stairs down to Floor 1

guild_trial1.name: Guild Trial I
guild_trial1.desc: Prove yourself to your guild. Defeat 12 enemies.

guild_trial2.name: Guild Trial II
guild_trial2.desc: Your guild wants more. Defeat 25 enemies and a camp leader.

guild_trial3.name: Guild Trial III
guild_trial3.desc: The final trial. Defeat 40 enemies on a single floor.

arrival.name: Welcome to the Dungeon
arrival.desc: You made it down the stairs. Find Marta Vance in Stairwell Camp. She runs the place.

obj.label: Talk to Marta Vance (the ! in camp)

nobody_out.name: Nobody Gets Out
nobody_out.desc: Marta says no contestant has ever reached Floor 18. Start by finding the Exit Sign everyone talks about.

the_stairs.name: The Chained Stairwell
the_stairs.desc: The stairwell door down is chained, and Sergeant Pylon holds the key. Kill him, or make a deal through Pickles.

obj.label: Deal with Sergeant Pylon (kill him, or broker a truce)

water_line.name: Thin the Packs
water_line.desc: Goblin packs keep raiding the camp water line. Kill 6 goblins anywhere on the floor.

find_leak.name: Find the Leak
find_leak.desc: Someone has to find where the water’s going. Check the Ramp Spiral and the Burning Bus.

cone_collector.name: Cone Collector
cone_collector.desc: Pickles wants 12 Cone Plastic, “for reasons”. Goblins drop it.

cone_coup.name: Cone Coup
cone_coup.desc: Pylon plans to cone off the stairwell and charge a toll forever. Pickles wants him made an example of.

bo_toolbox.name: Bo’s Toolbox
bo_toolbox.desc: Bo dropped a toolbox near the Ramp Spiral and goblins took the springs. Find the box and bring 3 Mimic Springs.

obj.label: Find the toolbox at the Ramp Spiral

dave_jars.name: Coin Jar Raid
dave_jars.desc: Goblins and wights stole Spin’s coin jars. Clear out 10 of them on Spin City to get the coins back for Dave.

clocking_out.name: Clocking Out
clocking_out.desc: Old Reggie’s partner Ebb is still “on shift” in Boiler Room 0. Find Ebb’s timecard there.

obj.label: Find Ebb’s timecard in Boiler Room 0

reggie_end.name: End of Shift
reggie_end.desc: Reggie can’t bear it. Put Head Custodian Ebb to rest yourself.

soup_feud.name: Soup Feud
soup_feud.desc: Two hag families run rival kitchens and their feud is poisoning the district. Taste-test both recipes, then come back to Wickley.

cone_king.name: Long Live the Cone
cone_king.desc: The stairs to Floor 4 run under the Cone King’s throne in the Cone Cathedral. He is not going to move for you.

lights_out.name: Lights Out
lights_out.desc: Moths swarm Soup Row every night. Brother Ash wants you to track their Queen to the Lamp Market.

ash_queen.name: The Last Light
ash_queen.desc: You chose to end the Bulb Queen. Brother Ash will pray for both of you.

five_stars.name: Five Stars
five_stars.desc: Judge Vrask is reviewing the Soup District. Cook something at your Cookstove and bring it to the judge.

coneCrown.name: Cone Crown
coneCrown.host: Five cones, one crown. Fashion has never been this orange.

goblinPass.name: Goblin Pass
goblinPass.host: A laminated cone. The goblins respect it. Mostly.

mothTrophy.name: Moth Queen’s Filament
mothTrophy.host: Still warm. Still glowing. Still a bit sad.

criticSeal.name: Critic’s Seal
criticSeal.host: Five stars. From an actual alien. Frame it.

recipeBook.name: Hag Recipe Book
recipeBook.host: Page 12: Soup. Page 13: More soup. Page 14: Do not read aloud.

keyring.name: Custodian’s Keyring
keyring.host: Forty years of keys. One of them opens something. Nobody knows what.
